**The meaning of the verses**
So Allah tested and tried them: their fish used to come to them on the Sabbath in great numbers, visible on the surface of the sea close to the shore, and when the Sabbath was over, the fish went off into the sea and they saw none of them. So they used tricks to trap them on the Sabbath in pits, and caught them after it.

﴿وَإِذْ قَالَتْ أُمَّةٌ مِّنْهُمْ لِمَ تَعِظُونَ قَوْمًا ۙ اللَّهُ مُهْلِكُهُمْ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۖ قَالُوا مَعْذِرَةً إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ﴾

And remember, O Messenger, when a group of them said to another group who were admonishing those who transgressed on the Sabbath and forbidding them from disobeying Allah on it: "Why do you admonish a people whom Allah will destroy in this world for disobeying Him, or punish with a severe punishment in the Hereafter?" Those who were forbidding them from disobeying Allah said: "We admonish them and forbid them so that we are excused regarding them, and so that we fulfil what Allah has made obligatory on us of enjoining good and forbidding evil, and in the hope that they will fear Allah, be afraid of Him, and repent from disobeying their Lord and transgressing what He has forbidden them."

﴿فَلَمَّا نَسُوا مَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ أَنجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ السُّوءِ وَأَخَذْنَا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا بِعَذَابٍ بَئِيسٍ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ﴾

So when the group who transgressed on the Sabbath abandoned what they had been reminded of, persisted in their error and transgression, and did not respond to the admonishing group's advice, Allah saved those who forbade disobeying Him, and seized those who transgressed on the Sabbath with a painful, severe punishment, because they went against Allah's command and departed from obeying Him.

📖 At-Tafsir Al-Muyassar — King Fahd Complex.

**Talk with your child**
1. What did the tricksters do to get the fish? And why was their trick not obedience, even though they did not catch fish on the Sabbath?
2. The people of the town split into three groups: what were they? And whom did Allah say He saved? (Those who forbade wrongdoing.)
3. If you see your friend doing something wrong, what do you say to them? And how? (You advise them kindly and gently, and if they do not listen, you tell the grown-ups. And do not say, "There's no use.")

**This week's exercise**
Look together this week for a little "trick" at home: like being asked to tidy the room and pushing things under the bed, or finishing homework by writing it in a rush without understanding. If your child finds one in themselves, they put it right the way it was really meant, not the way it looks.
